public.text: The section does not describe how adapters and mappings are tested or governed, although they can materially affect clinical meaning and safety.
public.suggestedRevision: Require mapping review, representative test cases, round-trip testing where appropriate, terminology validation, regression testing, clinical-safety review, version control, and monitoring of transformation errors.
